pages.text: The Spirit Instrument switches between Exploration, Wrench, Pickaxe and Building. It cannot receive random enchanting-table results, but anvils accept the current Netherite Pickaxe enchantment set.

Exploration toggles on air use and transfers an opened chest, barrel or Lootr page only while the enabled Instrument remains held. Wrench uses public wrench semantics and safely shift-dismantles owned ImmortalStorage machines.

Pickaxe has Netherite tier; left mining uses Fortune/Silk Touch and durability. From stage six, right-use spends one Immortal Power for fixed precise harvest independent of enchantments. Building previews and places up to 64 by default; hold the rebindable special-action key (grave accent by default) while using to delete a layer without drops. Use the same key with an empty hand to summon a Spirit Sword from the embedded furnace, or while holding one to return it.
